cues: Now the proof that it is really the night that counts.
Give a long night, but break it in the middle with a brief flash of light.
The short-day plant now fails to flower, and the long-day plant flowers.
A flash in the middle of the day does nothing.
So these plants measure the length of unbroken darkness.
